title: Distinct Administrator Access Screen Layout (Admin Password Gate) + i18n Polish

requirements.summary: Render an Administrator-specific access screen layout for the admin password gate (distinct from Parent/Child UI) while preserving the existing gate functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: When `isAdmin === true` and `isGatePassed === false`, the app renders an Administrator-specific access screen with a noticeably different layout/visual styling from the Parent/Child screens.

The Administrator access screen continues to use the existing admin password verification flow (no loss of functionality: verify password, allowlisted password change tab, show/hide password toggles, success/error toasts).
The Parent and Child experiences (including their dashboards and general app shell) remain unchanged in behavior.

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated Administrator access screen wrapper that uses the existing AdminPasswordGate component but presents it in a distinct admin-only layout (unique background, header/intro, and container styling). Use shadcn/ui building blocks (e.g., Card/Button) for consistent UI primitives. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new Administrator-specific access screen so that when `isAdmin && !isGatePassed`, the app renders the new AdminAccessScreen (instead of the standard app shell), without changing Parent/Child flows or the authenticated admin dashboard behavior.

requirements.summary: Source all Administrator access-screen user-facing text from i18n (EN + pt-BR) and remove any newly introduced hard-coded strings from the admin gate UI.
acceptanceCriteria: No hard-coded Portuguese-only strings are introduced in the new/updated Administrator access screen UI; strings are pulled from the i18n translation dictionaries.
English translations exist for any new keys used by the Administrator access screen.

file_operations.description: Add English translation keys needed by the new Administrator access screen (e.g., admin-specific heading/subheading/help text) and for any new/updated AdminPasswordGate accessibility labels (e.g., show/hide password aria-label text).
Add pt-BR equivalents for all new Administrator access screen keys and any new/updated AdminPasswordGate accessibility label keys to keep parity with English.

Replace hard-coded user-facing strings in the Administrator gate UI that are not currently i18n-sourced (notably the show/hide password aria-labels) with i18n keys via useI18n(), keeping the existing verification/change-password behavior and toast flow intact.
